annotations.title: Check which moves a Pokémon can learn

description: Check whether a Pokémon can learn each of the given moves in any Pokémon game, counting moves inherited from its pre-evolutions and base form. Based on Pokémon Showdown learnset data across all generations, not Pokémon Champions' own move lists: a move learnable only in an older game may not exist in Champions, and a move added only in Champions may be reported as not learnable.
